question: What will be the voter turnout percentage reported for Phase 1 of Rajasthan's 2026 Zila Parishad and Panchayat Samiti member elections (voting October 13, 2026)?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Rajasthan ZP/PS member election phase turnouts 2020-21, clustered ~61-64% (2020 final phase ~62% at 5pm). These are EVM polls separate from the ballot-paper panch/sarpanch polls, which typically see much higher turnout (~80%), so sarpanch-level turnout should not carry over. Each 2026 phase spans many districts, so the phase average should be near the statewide mean. 2026 urban civic turnout was reported in the 60s-70s, a modest upward pull. Schedule sources conflict: ANI, Gujarat Samachar and others put Phase 1 ZP/PS on Oct 23, so the question may be annulled; this distribution is conditional on resolution. No human market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Schedule conflict (Oct 2026 reports): ZoomNews says Phase 1 ZP/PS is Oct 13, panch/sarpanch Oct 14, up-sarpanch Oct 15, then phases Oct 23/29/Nov 3. ANI/Gujarat Samachar/Statesman-based summaries say Phase 1 ZP/PS is Oct 23, then Oct 29, Nov 4, Nov 14. Udaipur Times says Oct 25/31/Nov 6/Nov 16. If Phase 1 is not held by Oct 16 with a reported figure, the question annuls.
- Voting method (Udaipur Times, Oct 2026): ZP/PS members on EVMs; sarpanch/ward panch on ballot papers; held on different days, not simultaneously.
- Scale (search summaries, Oct 2026): 41 ZPs (1,403 members), 457 PS (8,245 members), 14,403 GPs; 4,03,07,308 voters; 45,384 polling stations. Districts are split across phases (some in 1 phase, Jaipur in 4, most in 2-3), so each phase is a multi-district mix.
- History: Nov-Dec 2020 ZP/PS four-phase cycle: 4th phase ~62% till 5pm (Deccan Herald); overall cycle ~62% per question background. Phase 1 on Nov 23, 2020 covered 21 districts; its final figure was not found in search.
- 2021 six-district ZP/PS cycle: phase 1 had 26.81% at noon (Outlook); question background puts 2021 phase-1 finals at ~61-64%.
- Rajasthan gram panchayat (sarpanch) phases historically ~80%+ (2020 sarpanch phase ~83%, Deccan Herald). Different tier, ballot-paper poll.
- 2026 Rajasthan urban civic polls: phase-1 figures reported variously as 63.55% (Statesman, provisional) and 72.09% (Statesman/ETV, later); question background says 76.4% phase 1 and ~70-71% phase 2.
- Resolves off the SEC Rajasthan consolidated Phase 1 ZP/PS figure (Panchayat Samiti figure if split), not panch/sarpanch turnout.
- Event window: Phase 1 polling day (Oct 13 per question) -> resolution Oct 16, 2026; as of Oct 5 polling has not occurred.
- Searched, not found: official SEC phase-1 district list for 2026; exact 2020 phase-1 final ZP/PS turnout; any prediction market (none on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi).
calls.reference_class: Phase-level turnout in Rajasthan Zila Parishad/Panchayat Samiti member elections (2020 four-phase cycle and 2021 district cycles)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Phase 1 turnout in Rajasthan Zila Parishad / Panchayat Samiti member elections, which clusters at 62-64% (Aug 2021 six districts: just over 62%; Oct 2021 Alwar/Dholpur: 64.24%; 2020 Phase 4: about 62%). Adjusted up modestly because 2020-21 was held during COVID and the 2026 urban local body Phase 1 turnout was high (76.4%). Wide tails because sources disagree on whether member voting is on its own day or shares a day with Sarpanch voting; a shared day pushes toward the 75-83% Sarpanch levels. Phase 1 districts are unknown. Market check: none found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or any bookmaker.
sources: WebSearch results: Deccan Herald '62% polling in 4th phase of Rajasthan panchayat election'; Patrika Alwar Oct 2021 phase figures
calls.dossier:
- Schedule conflict (Oct 2026 reports): zoomnews.in says Zila Parishad/Panchayat Samiti member voting is Oct 13, Oct 23, Oct 29 and Nov 3, 2026, with Panch/Sarpanch voting the following day in each case (Oct 14, 24, 30, Nov 4). A search snippet of The Statesman says member polling is Oct 23, Oct 29, Nov 4 and Nov 14, with Oct 13 being the last date for Phase 1 nominations. Udaipur Times says Oct 25, Oct 31, Nov 6 and Nov 16, with the same dates for member and Sarpanch voting. The official SEC schedule was not retrieved; it is unresolved whether Phase 1 is on Oct 13 and whether member and Sarpanch voting share a day.
- Electorate about 4.02-4.03 crore; 41 Zila Parishads, 457 Panchayat Samitis (Udaipur Times; question background). Phase 1 districts not found.
- Aug 2021, 6 districts (Bharatpur, Dausa, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Sawai Madhopur, Sirohi), Phase 1 for Zila Parishad/Panchayat Samiti members: 26.81% by noon, overall just over 62% (Outlook; SEC).
- Oct 2021, Alwar and Dholpur, member elections: Phase 1 (Oct 20) 64.24%, Phase 2 (Oct 23) 57.46% (Patrika, via search).
- Nov-Dec 2020, 21 districts, member elections in 4 phases (Nov 23 to Dec 5), held during COVID: Phase 4 about 62% (Deccan Herald). Phase 1 figure searched for but not found; question background gives the overall cycle as about 62%.
- Contrast: Sarpanch-level polls in Rajasthan run higher; one 2020-21 Sarpanch phase recorded about 83% by 5:30 PM (Deccan Herald).
- Contrast: 2026 urban local body Phase 1 turnout was 76.41% (ThePrint Hindi); about 72% was reported early (ETV Bharat); Phase 2 was about 70-71%. Earlier urban rounds: 2021 Phase 2 70.68%, overall 72.95% (The Hawk).
- Status quo: member-election phases have landed in 57-64% over 2020-21.
- Resolves off the SEC Rajasthan figure for Phase 1 Zila Parishad/Panchayat Samiti member voting (the Panchayat Samiti figure if reported separately), not Sarpanch turnout; the latest consolidated figure supersedes the 5 PM figure.
- Event window: Phase 1 polling day (the criteria say Oct 13, 2026) through resolution on Oct 16, 2026. As of Oct 5 the event has not occurred (0% elapsed). If polling moves past Oct 16, the question is annulled.

calls.reasoning: Prior Zila Parishad/Panchayat Samiti member-election phases in Rajasthan cluster around 62–64%. In 2020 overall turnout was about 62% and Phase 4 about 62%. In Aug 2021 Phase 1 across six districts came in just over 62%; Oct 2021 Phase 1 in Alwar and Dholpur was 64.24% and Phase 2 was 57.46%. I start from about 62.5%. I add about one point for the following: 2020–21 polls were held during COVID, the 2026 urban local body polls had high turnout (72–76%), and these long-delayed polls cover all 41 districts. I take a little back for harvest season and because each phase mixes many districts. These member polls use EVMs and are held on a different day from the sarpanch ballot-paper polls, which run at 80%+, so sarpanch-level turnout should not carry over. The distribution is conditional on resolution: if Phase 1 is really on Oct 23, the question is annulled. Market check: no human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.reconciliation: There were three disputes. (1) Phase 1 date, Oct 13 or Oct 23. This is factual and could not be settled without web access; the dossiers conflict, and Run 3 cites an official Oct 3 announcement giving Oct 23. It only affects whether the question is annulled. My percentiles are conditional on a Phase 1 figure existing, so I did not shift them. (2) Whether member voting shares a day with sarpanch voting. This is factual. Run 2 widened its upper tail on this, but the ZoomNews and Udaipur Times reports in the dossiers both say the polls are held on different days. Every schedule version gives member and sarpanch polls different dates, so I dropped Run 2's extra upper tail. (3) How much the high 2026 urban turnout should lift rural turnout. This is a judgment call. Urban and rural patterns differ, and the 2021 rural member polls came after the 2020 urban polls without rising much, so I give it a modest lift of about one point, the same as Run 1. I agree with the runs' reference class.

disagreements.claim: Phase 1 ZP/PS polling is Oct 13 (vs Oct 23 per ANI/Statesman)
disagreements.verdict: Unresolved without web access. It affects annulment only, and the percentiles are conditional on resolution.

disagreements.claim: Member and sarpanch voting share a polling day, pushing turnout toward 75–83%
disagreements.verdict: Mostly rejected. The dossiers' sources say the polls are on different days, so the extra upper tail was dropped.

disagreements.claim: High 2026 urban turnout implies materially higher rural member turnout
disagreements.verdict: Small upward adjustment of about 1pp; the urban–rural gap is persistent.

calls.reference_class: Phase turnouts in Rajasthan Zila Parishad/Panchayat Samiti member elections, 2020–2021 cycles
